selection_rule: per model: lowest mean es_loss over tune seeds (minirocket: highest mean es AUROC); every config within one standard error (over seeds, of the best config) of the best is eligible; among the eligible the default config, else the smallest (parameters; hgb max_leaf_nodes; logreg C; minirocket kernels), else the best.
tuning_leakage_note: Tuning on fold 0 trains and early-stops on rows that are TEST rows of folds 1-4, so the frozen hyper-parameters carry information from those rows' labels. Results on fold 0 alone are the strictly clean slice (re-score from the stored predictions).
